recipes.comment: task p31-qu-a-foundation smoke row — a DECLARED stand-in, not an upstream transcription: the upstream Molecular Scanner rows are runtime USB-scan synthesis (RecipeMapScannerMolecular.java:57-61 — a SCANNABLE item + a T3 USB stick in, the stick back with NBT_REPLICATOR_DATA, power (protons+neutrons)*512 eut 512), LIVE since task p32-qu-scanner-replicator (the GT6RecipeMapScannerMolecular synthesis over the GT6UsbSticks carrier — the synthesis builds one-time rows at findRecipe, never a static stock). The row keeps the 2-in/1-out map shape with vanilla items (the scanned material stand-in ender_pearl + the data-medium stand-in paper → the medium back, the scan data itself being NBT the v1 row schema cannot carry), so the map keeps a visible static row; the real rows are the runtime synthesis.
